inputs.original_text: This is being presented as generosity, but it looks like a loyalty-buying operation. Bigger monthly aid for women, Rs 8,000 household coupons, free pumpsets for farmers, and promises to fishermen are the visible bait, while talk of FDI, jobs, and AI provides a modern gloss. The real question is who will profit from investment and technology while the public is encouraged to focus on handouts. These promises don’t prove public-minded intentions; they look designed to secure support and keep deeper interests out of sight.
